targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE reason
    WHEN 'guardrail'      THEN 'guardrail'
    WHEN 'budget'       THEN 'budget'
    WHEN 'rate limit'     THEN 'rate limit'
    WHEN 'model not allowed' THEN 'model not allowed'
    ELSE 'other' END AS "Reason", count(*) AS "Count"
FROM ai_router_blocked_audit
WHERE ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT pattern AS "Pattern", count(*) AS "Detections"
FROM ai_router_blocked_audit
WHERE ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND reason='guardrail' AND pattern IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts,'5m'), CASE reason
    WHEN 'guardrail'      THEN 'guardrail'
    WHEN 'budget'       THEN 'budget'
    WHEN 'rate limit'     THEN 'rate limit'
    WHEN 'model not allowed' THEN 'model not allowed'
    ELSE 'other' END AS metric, count(*) AS "count"
FROM ai_router_blocked_audit
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT ts AS "Time", key_alias AS "Key", user_name AS "User",
       CASE reason
    WHEN 'guardrail'      THEN 'guardrail'
    WHEN 'budget'       THEN 'budget'
    WHEN 'rate limit'     THEN 'rate limit'
    WHEN 'model not allowed' THEN 'model not allowed'
    ELSE 'other' END AS "Reason", COALESCE(pattern,'-') AS "Pattern",
       COALESCE(stage,'-') AS "Stage", code AS "Code", COALESCE(source_ip,'-') AS "Source IP"
FROM ai_router_blocked_audit
WHERE ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT key_alias AS "Key", user_name AS "User", count(*) AS "Calls",
       sum(total_tokens) AS "Tokens", round(sum(cost_usd),6) AS "USD"
FROM ai_router_egress_audit
WHERE ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 5 DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT served_by AS "Model", count(*) AS "Calls",
       sum(total_tokens) AS "Tokens", round(sum(cost_usd),6) AS "USD"
FROM ai_router_egress_audit
WHERE ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 4 DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT ts AS "Time", key_alias AS "Key",
       COALESCE(requested_alias,'-') AS "Requested",
       COALESCE(router_chose,'-')    AS "Router chose",
       COALESCE(tier,'-')             AS "Tier",
       served_by                 AS "Served by",
       CASE
         WHEN router_chose IS NULL THEN '-'
         WHEN router_chose='frontier'      AND served_by LIKE '%opus%'   THEN 'ok'
         WHEN router_chose='frontier-mid'  AND served_by LIKE '%sonnet%' THEN 'ok'
         WHEN router_chose='frontier-fast' AND served_by LIKE '%haiku%'  THEN 'ok'
         WHEN router_chose='fast-local'    AND served_by LIKE '%qwen%'   THEN 'ok'
         ELSE 'MISMATCH'
       END AS "Match",
       cost_usd AS "USD"
FROM ai_router_egress_audit
WHERE ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 100
